known_before_freeze: every primary AUC, MAC and recorded wall value (published by #101/#114/#105 and Gate B), the #74 proxy table; no policy output on the secondary set with the Gate-B predictors existed; the frontier, shares, verdicts and the ICLR-sentence token had not been computed

primary.anchors: Gate-B anchor store (E99); #105 F77 store for the #78 ports
primary.cells: Gate-B mixed cells of the #109 evaluation split (#104 campaign pig-removal verdicts)
primary.reuse: every policy's canonical retained record (source per policy in 'policies'); retained records score exactly these cells, anchors, predictors and policies under the #111 contract; reuse fidelity is G1

rules.axes: x: linear MACs per candidate rollout to step 225 (predictor transitions + policy calls; #96/#101 accounting, nonlinear work excluded), pooled over seeds and cells; or wall seconds per state = CUDA-synchronized host elapsed seconds of one state's batched rollout (all candidates), measured in a uniform timing pass (primary: seed 20260908, every cell; secondary: this scoring, all seeds), one process per RTX 5090 after a discarded warm-up cell. The prior has 0 model MACs and is not timed (0). y: tie-free AUC (member-mean of cell AUCs, m99.view) or top-3 hit rate (#114 view).
rules.bootstrap_frontier_share: members (levels) resampled jointly for all policies with the p94 generator (PCG64 7201, 10000 draws); each policy's draw value = mean of its defined cluster means among the drawn members; x held fixed (compute uncertainty not modelled); share = fraction of draws on the Pareto set. DESCRIPTIVE.
rules.guards: G1 reuse fidelity: the timing pass reproduces every retained primary record on every seed-20260908 cell (rows, schedules, MACs, calls); G2 arms recorded by two sources are identical; G3 every record under scoring_harness.SCORING_POLICY; G4 frozen inputs unchanged; G5 freeze before the first new record; G6 secondary inputs equal the frozen counts and anchors. A failed guard turns every token (dominance contrasts and the ICLR sentence) into readiness_or_precision_insufficient.
rules.iclr_sentence: 'matches a horizon-only adaptive baseline at a third of its compute' on the primary grid with the transferred ICLR operating recipe: J = J-1e-04 against the horizon-only adaptive C-J = CJ-1e-04. 'a third' holds iff J's MACs per candidate-state <= 0.4 x C-J's; 'matches' holds iff the paired J - C-J AUC lower bound > -0.02 (non-inferiority at delta). supported iff both; not_supported_by_this_experiment iff 'a third' fails or the upper bound < -0.02; else readiness_or_precision_insufficient; any failed guard -> readiness_or_precision_insufficient. The other J lambdas and the frontier status are reported DESCRIPTIVE. The same rule is reported on the secondary set (DESCRIPTIVE). If the primary token is not 'supported', a MANUSCRIPT ticket is opened (#103 acceptance).
rules.pareto: point Pareto set per (set, inventory, axis pair): a policy is dominated iff another has x <= and y >= with at least one strict; identical points do not dominate each other.
rules.verdict: per policy (AUC x MACs, and stored for every axis pair): 'on the frontier' with its share, or 'dominated by Q' with Q = the dominator with the highest AUC (ties: fewer MACs), the paired Q - P difference (member-clustered) and its delta token; the delta rule is the only wording for differences.

secondary.anchors: E99: #112 v1 parses of p94.frozen_anchor (retained); F77 (#78 ports): parsed here (--anchors) from the same frames
secondary.cells: #96 universe: #93 Arm B grid (16), #93 Arm A offset (11), #87 + #89 angle (9-13; #89 typed-unmeasurable states excluded), #94 power (20); first_shot_success engine verdicts; mixed member cells
secondary.disclosure: N1 lineages: the E99 encoder (#99) was fitted on the 11 non-held-out lineages and the #78 ports were trained on N1 lineages; the LC predictors and all policies never saw them
secondary.prior: Gate-B rule (fit-split success frequency of the identical action; unseen -> 0)
